one_line: Composer-scribe Vasuvarma and coppersmith Kaliya who recorded the Nidhanpur land grant on the Kamarupa–Bengal frontier.

appearance.age_look: late 20s to early 30s, lean scholar-artisan builds with modest muscle from travel and manual work
appearance.face: Vasuvarma has an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed short beard and thoughtful, alert eyes; Kaliya has a slightly broader face, deeper brown complexion, faint forge-scar on one cheek and a calm, steady gaze; both usually wear a focused, serious expression with a hint of quiet pride.
appearance.hair: Vasuvarma’s straight black hair is tied in a small, neat topknot at the back of his crown with a thin red cord, with a short fringe parted slightly off-center; Kaliya’s black hair is shoulder-length, combed back and tied low at the nape in a simple cord, with a few loose strands near the temples; neither wears a turban or helmet.
appearance.costume: Both wear early-medieval eastern Indian attire suited to administrators and artisans in a humid frontier region: Vasuvarma wears a knee-length off-white cotton uttariya-style upper cloth wrapped diagonally over his left shoulder and around the torso, covering the chest fully, over a finely pleated ankle-length pale indigo cotton dhoti with a dark blue border, tied high at the waist; his dhoti is worn slightly narrow to allow walking, and he has a thin brown leather waist-belt from which a small palm-leaf manuscript pouch hangs; he wears simple dark wooden bead bracelets on both wrists and thin anklets, and leather sandals; Kaliya wears a thicker, sturdy knee-length dull-ochre cotton tunic with elbow-length sleeves, fully covering his torso, with a simple round neck, over a mid-calf length dark brown wrap-around lower cloth (like a practical dhoti) with a brick-red border, tied securely; a broad woven russet sash crosses his chest from right shoulder to left hip to support tools; his forearms are wrapped with dark cloth bands for protection, and he wears open leather sandals and a simple copper neck torque as a sign of his craft.
appearance.signature: Vasuvarma carries a narrow rectangular copperplate bundle tied with a dark cord and a reed stylus tucked into his belt, while Kaliya carries a single polished copperplate held in his left hand and a short, slightly curved chasing chisel and small hammer at his waist, their surfaces gleaming with recent engraving.

ref_desc: Vasuvarma has a neat topknot, short beard, off-white upper cloth and pale indigo dhoti with dark blue border, carrying tied copperplates and a reed stylus, while Kaliya has shoulder-length tied-back hair, ochre tunic, dark brown lower cloth with brick-red border and copperplate with tools.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two early-medieval Kamarupa frontier figures standing side by side: Vasuvarma, a lean medium-brown scholar in his late twenties with an oval face, thoughtful eyes and a neat black topknot with short fringe, a short beard, wearing a modest off-white cotton upper cloth wrapped diagonally to fully cover his torso over a finely pleated ankle-length pale indigo dhoti with a dark blue border, a thin brown leather waist-belt holding a small palm-leaf manuscript pouch, simple dark wooden bead bracelets, thin anklets and leather sandals, carrying a narrow bundle of copperplates tied with a dark cord in one hand and a reed stylus tucked into his belt; beside him Kaliya, slightly broader with a deeper brown complexion, calm steady gaze and a faint forge-scar on one cheek, black hair combed back and tied low with a few loose temple strands, dressed in a sturdy knee-length dull-ochre cotton tunic with elbow-length sleeves and round neck fully covering his torso, over a mid-calf dark brown wrap-around lower cloth with a brick-red border, secured at the waist, a broad woven russet sash crossing his chest from right shoulder to left hip supporting his tools, forearms wrapped in dark protective bands, wearing open leather sandals and a simple copper neck torque, holding a single polished copperplate in his left hand while a short curved chasing chisel and small hammer hang at his waist; emphasize the shared earthy palette of off-white, pale indigo, dark blue, dull ochre, dark brown, brick red and gleaming copper, with clean linework and consistent details visible from head to toe.
